newsitem.title: USA: Virginia jobless rate rises to 3.9 pct in December.
newsitem.headline: Virginia jobless rate rises to 3.9 pct in December.

text.p: Virginia's unemployment rate edged up slightly to 3.9 percent in December from 3.8 percent in November, Virginia Employment Commission said Monday.
The commission said retail employment grew in urban areas but outdoor work was stalled in rural areas because of bad weather.
Fairfax City had the lowest unemployment rate in December, 1.2 percent, and Dickenson County had the highest, 16.8 percent.
Among major metropolitan areas, the December unemployment rate was 2.4 percent in Charlottesville, 2.5 percent in Roanoke, 3.4 percent in Richmond and Lynchburg, and 4.5 percent in the Tidewater.
Virginia's average unemployment rate for 1996 was 4.2 percent, the lowest in seven years.
